prompts: Use case: illustration-story. Create a new 3:1 panoramic illustration using the attached image ONLY as a style reference: same tactile gouache paper forms, fine graphite details, cream and putty, mushroom grey, restrained rust red. Foreground objects on GENUINE transparent alpha background; no painted checkerboard or opaque background. No hands, people, desk, laptop, scenery, readable text, logos or arrows. Objects in a shallow horizontal band, ample transparent margins, nothing cut off. Subject: a personal routine taking shape. Three loose notes at left, a small open notebook with simple abstract checklist marks at centre, and a compact calendar page beside a neatly filed note at right. A fine understated graphite line links the groups. Warm, practical and quiet. Match the reference's simple recognisable work artefacts and scale.
